warning_signs_missed: 2026-06-19 - On day 3 she asked, in writing and with unusual precision, how the paid-traffic handover would work. We answered with a date and no plan. Everything that followed is downstream of that unwritten answer; a client who asks a structured question about the core deliverable is telling you where she will judge you.

2026-06-26 - We swapped her account manager mid-complaint with no introduction and no handover message. Her open question then sat until she wrote 'Why when i ask no one answer'. A silent personnel change is a churn accelerant and there is no rule requiring a handover note.

2026-06-28 - We switched off the only acquisition that was working on a verbal 'Yes there will be', and deleted her already-queued posts by mistake. From that day nobody on our side ever looked at her fan-growth numbers. The absence of a metric was itself the warning.
